words.gloss_range: opening resumptive and connective particle that launches the negated verdict as a boundary conclusion

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: negating particle that opens the predicate frame

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah as a boundary connector: the sentence is tied to the preceding revelation-proof, but it also resumes with a fresh universal verdict. Its fusion with {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}) means the transition and the negation arrive together, not as a neutral bridge followed by a separate denial. The later second connector creates a paired beat, so the ayah first opens the outer negated claim and then opens the inner concession.

topics.headline: resumptive boundary after narrative proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah is not merely continuing narration; it draws a general verdict from the preceding proof.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as coordinating or resumptive, and the local clause begins a negated nominal verdict after the prior narrative boundary.

topics.headline: connector fused to negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the transition and denial as one opening move rather than two separable steps.
topics.reason: The positioned particle immediately precedes the negator, matching the row's form-level observation.

topics.headline: paired connectors frame negation and concession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices two similar connector beats with different jobs: one opens the verdict, the other opens the concession.
topics.reason: The local word table has a first connector before the negation and a second connector before the concessive condition.

words.gloss_range: full-clause negator in a reinforced nominal-predicate frame, with scope held open until the final predicate

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: reinforcing predicate marker after the negator

words.prose: {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}) opens a negated nominal clause, so the ayah states a standing identity verdict rather than narrating one failed act. Its scope stretches across the majority phrase and the inserted concession until {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) and {{ar:مُؤْمِنِينَ}} ({{tr:muʾminīna}}) close the frame; the later marker locks the opening particle as negation rather than another particle type. That delay lets effort be heard inside the sentence without giving effort control over the predicate.

topics.headline: standing negated predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah denies a settled status, not just a one-time act of refusing.
topics.reason: The clause is identified as a negated nominal clause whose predicate is reinforced by the later predicate marker.

topics.headline: later predicate marker resolves the particle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees how the later predicate marker locks the opening particle into negation rather than another particle type.
topics.reason: The reinforcing predicate marker after the negator supports the negating parse and excludes alternative particle functions locally.

topics.headline: delayed predicate creates suspended verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the verdict held open while subject and effort pass through the frame before the predicate lands.
topics.reason: The main negation begins at word 2, the concessive clause is inserted, and the predicate closes at the end.

topics.headline: effort does not determine the verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the negative verdict limits responsibility for the outcome rather than blaming the addressee's effort.
topics.reason: The concessive clause is subordinate to the negated predicate, so effort is acknowledged but does not change the result.

words.gloss_range: elative majority head in a partitive construct, naming the measured human majority under negation rather than vague manyness
words.root_gloss_range: abundance, numerical increase, outnumbering, and excess; local grammar selects the elative majority branch while broader abundance imagery remains pressure only
words.prose: {{ar:أَكْثَرُ}} ({{tr:aktharu}}) is not a loose word for many; as an elative construct with {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nāsi}}), it names the majority fraction of the human set. The root's abundance pressure makes that majority feel like massed number, but the local form ranks a population rather than activating every abundance branch, and that numerical dominance is evaluated negatively by the final belief-status predicate. Surah 12's repeated majority formula now turns from failures of knowing (12:21, 12:38, 12:40, 12:68) toward the final belief-status verdict, with parallels to majority-unbelief wording in 11:17 and 13:1. A local guttural and nasal sound thread also helps bind the separated majority phrase to {{ar:مُؤْمِنِينَ}} ({{tr:muʾminīna}}) after the inserted concession.

topics.headline: majority fraction as subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a measured majority fraction, not a vague crowd, as the subject of the negated verdict.
topics.reason: The word is nominative and governs the following genitive complement, fixing a partitive subject under negation.

topics.headline: abundance becomes evaluated number
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the large side of the human count evaluated negatively rather than treated as social proof.
topics.reason: V4 supports abundance and numerical increase for the root, while the local elative construct narrows the active sense to majority rather than all abundance branches.

topics.headline: majority refrain redirected into belief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes this majority phrase as a closing turn in a recurring formula, not an isolated statistic.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply concrete same-surah and cross-surah references, and no local evidence blocks formulaic comparison.

topics.headline: number set against belief status
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's lexical tension between numerical dominance and belief-status.
topics.reason: The local predicate is the belief-status term, and the contextual profile shows the population and belief fields can be read together without forcing a new root sense.

topics.headline: sound binds separated subject and predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a light sound thread tying the majority phrase to the final predicate despite the inserted concession.
topics.reason: The sound observation is local and modest, so it survives as a small acoustic payoff.

words.gloss_range: definite collective human population measured by the preceding majority term, with social-human root pressure but not a narrow local crowd

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: majority head governing the people noun

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nāsi}}) is genitive under {{ar:أَكْثَرُ}} ({{tr:aktharu}}), so it supplies the measured population rather than acting as a second subject. Its definiteness makes the population a known human class, and the broader formula selects humanity rather than one local crowd; in recitation the article is audibly fused into the people-word, reinforcing that totalizing definiteness. The root-pressure of social familiarity, with the contested forgetfulness line kept only as background, sharpens the irony: socially familiar human beings become the majority field in which belief-status is not reached. Surah 12's repeated human references (12:21, 12:38, 12:40, 12:46, 12:68) are gathered into this final general claim, while 10:99 clarifies that this human field is not moved into belief by compulsion.

topics.headline: definite people as measured set
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word supplies the known human population from which the majority is measured.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence forces the word as genitive complement of the majority term, and the definite collective noun supports the broad human set.

topics.headline: social humanity under negated belief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the irony that socially familiar humanity is the very field where the belief-security status is mostly absent.
topics.reason: The local noun remains the people/humanity term; the sociality and forgetfulness derivational lines survive as pressure, not as replacement senses.

topics.headline: people as the affected field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the addressee's intense effort concerns this human field, while the grammar still measures it through the majority phrase.
topics.reason: The word is grammatically dependent on the majority term, while the surrounding concession and predicate make the same group the affected human field.

topics.headline: human category threaded through the surah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the human category at the end of the narrative as part of Surah 12's repeated reflection on human limitation.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete same-surah recurrence points, and the local generic phrase supports a surah-level human category.

topics.headline: recited definiteness fused to the people-word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the definite article's force as fused into the people-word rather than as a detachable marker.
topics.reason: The sound observation supports the same definiteness payoff already visible in the written and grammatical form.

words.gloss_range: concessive connector fused with the following condition particle, inserting effort into the negated verdict without starting a second verdict

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: intense eagerness verb in the inserted concession

words.prose: The second {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) belongs to {{ar:وَلَوْ}} ({{tr:wa-law}}), so it does not simply add another statement. It fuses with {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}) to insert a concession between the subject and predicate: even the pressure of {{ar:حَرَصْتَ}} ({{tr:ḥaraṣta}}) remains inside the same negated verdict. Its echo with the opening connector gives the ayah two gates, first verdict and then concession.

topics.headline: connector fused into concession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this connector as part of a concessive particle group, not as a plain additive conjunction.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the sequence as a concessive condition linked to the main negated clause.

topics.headline: effort inserted before predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that maximum effort is placed at the center of the syntax while remaining subordinate to the verdict.
topics.reason: The concessive clause sits between the majority subject and the delayed predicate.

topics.headline: same connector sound, changed function
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same connector sound doing a second, more concessive job inside the ayah.
topics.reason: The local repetition of the connector before different particles supports the structural and acoustic observation.

words.gloss_range: concessive hypothetical condition particle whose answer is recovered from the surrounding negated verdict

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: concessive connector fused to the condition particle
perfect verb of intense eagerness inside the condition

words.prose: {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}) makes the middle clause concessive and hypothetical: the sentence tests even the maximum case of eagerness. Its answer is not repeated because the surrounding negated verdict supplies it, so the condition remains compact rather than becoming a second sentence. The construction also echoes the limit-of-effort pattern with the same desire root in 4:129.

topics.headline: condition subordinated to main negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the condition is subordinate to the already stated negative verdict, not a possible escape from it.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the clause as a concessive conditional protasis linked to the main negated clause.

topics.headline: maximum case without causal control
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the sentence testing the strongest imaginable eagerness while still denying that it controls belief.
topics.reason: The particle has hypothetical and concessive force here; claims of impossibility are kept as rhetorical maximum rather than a separate metaphysical claim.

topics.headline: omitted answer and effort-limit echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the compact grammar and the echo with 4:129 as two ways the particle marks effort meeting a limit.
topics.reason: The condition's answer is recoverable from the surrounding negation, and the CRITICAL row supplies a concrete 4:129 parallel.

words.gloss_range: objectless perfect second-person verb of intense eagerness inside a concessive limit frame
words.root_gloss_range: scraping or tearing pressure, intense desire, greed, zeal, and a rare middle-place branch; local grammar selects intense eagerness while scraping remains image-pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: concessive hypothetical particle governing the verb
final believer-status predicate that supplies the implied desired outcome

words.prose: {{ar:حَرَصْتَ}} ({{tr:ḥaraṣta}}) names intense eagerness, not ordinary effort, and it appears without an explicit object. That gap makes the desire lean forward into the final predicate, while {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}) keeps the whole effort inside a concession. The root's scraping image makes the desire feel like pressure against resistance, but the local sense remains eager striving. The perfect Form I verb presents eagerness as an exerted event inside the condition rather than a mere adjective or settled trait, and the second-person ending directly addresses the addressee. The form joins a rare limit-of-effort pattern with 4:129, while echoes with 2:96, 9:128, and 16:37 show the root moving between human craving, prophetic concern, and guidance-effort that cannot guarantee belief.

topics.headline: desire without an explicit object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices desire stretching toward the final predicate instead of closing on a named object.
topics.reason: The verb instance has no overt object, and the final predicate supplies the recoverable desired outcome.

topics.headline: direct addressee inside the concession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the addressee placed directly inside the limit statement through the verb ending itself.
topics.reason: The perfect 2ms morphology supplies the implicit subject and keeps the effort clause compressed.

topics.headline: scraping image behind intense desire
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels eagerness as exerted pressure against resistance, while the local verb still means intense desire.
topics.reason: V4 distinguishes scraping and intense-desire branches; the local concession selects intense desire while allowing scraping as image-pressure.

topics.headline: eventive perfect rather than mere trait
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices eagerness as an exerted condition in the sentence, not merely an adjective describing character.
topics.reason: The local surface is a perfect Form I verb inside the condition, not an adjective or imperfect form.

topics.headline: rare root in effort-limit parallels
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes this rare desire root as part of a pattern where intense human effort meets a boundary it cannot cross.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks the exact form as low occurrence, and the CRITICAL rows supply concrete parallels including 4:129, 2:96, 9:128, and 16:37.

topics.headline: effort centered after narrative boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the addressee's effort made visible at the sentence center while the surrounding frame denies it final control.
topics.reason: The verb is inserted between the majority subject and final predicate and follows the prior narrative report's direct-address movement.

words.gloss_range: reinforcing predicate marker in the negated frame, with ordinary prepositional meanings receding into emphatic attachment

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: opening negator paired with the predicate marker
predicate governed by the reinforcing particle

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is the delayed predicate marker that confirms the negating frame opened by {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}). Here its ordinary instrument or accompaniment meanings recede; its local work is emphatic negated predication. Still, the attachment pressure of the particle is not empty: it makes the denial cling to {{ar:مُؤْمِنِينَ}} ({{tr:muʾminīna}}) exactly where the suspended predicate lands.

topics.headline: reinforcing predicate marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final predicate marked as emphatically negated rather than as an ordinary prepositional phrase.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the particle as reinforcing the negated predicate.

topics.headline: attachment pressure inside reinforcement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the predicate denial as attached to the final identity term, while ordinary prepositional senses remain inactive.
topics.reason: Local syntax selects reinforcement, but the particle's attachment force can remain as image-pressure without activating instrument or accompaniment meanings.

topics.headline: delayed marker closes the frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the predicate marker closing a long-distance negation after the concession has been inserted.
topics.reason: The particle appears after the subject and concessive clause, linking back to the opening negator and forward to the predicate.

words.gloss_range: final indefinite plural active-participle predicate denying membership in the believer/trust-security class
words.root_gloss_range: security, trust, belief, entering safety, making safe, and seeking safe-conduct; local form selects the active believer-status identity while related security branches add pressure

measured human majority that receives the negated predicate

words.prose: {{ar:مُؤْمِنِينَ}} ({{tr:muʾminīna}}) is the final predicate landing of the whole ayah. As an indefinite plural active participle governed by {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}), it denies the majority membership in a believer class, not merely one act of believing. The root adds trust and security pressure to the belief label, while the local Form IV participle keeps the selected sense as active believer-status. Its delay until the end lets majority and effort be staged first; then the ayah closes on the identity most people do not attain. Echoes with 12:17, 12:37, 12:99, 12:106, 12:107, 11:17, and 13:1 make that closure part of a wider belief and security thread. The internal catch and long final cadence let the denied identity remain audible after the compact effort clause.

topics.headline: negated active-participle class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah denying class membership in an active believer identity, not just reporting a single unbelieving action.
topics.reason: The word is an indefinite masculine plural active participle functioning as the reinforced predicate of the negated nominal clause.

topics.headline: belief-status with trust-security pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels that the denied believer label also carries trust and security weight beneath the religious status term.
topics.reason: The local surface selects the believer active participle, while the root family supports security and trust pressure without replacing the predicate sense.

topics.headline: participle selected over abstract belief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the verdict focused on participant identity rather than on an abstract noun or a finite verbal event.
topics.reason: The chosen local form is a Form IV active participle, not an abstract noun or adjective.

topics.headline: belief verdict in echo field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the final word as the point where Surah 12's trust and belief thread becomes a broad majority verdict.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply concrete same-surah and cross-surah parallels, and the local final predicate supports formulaic comparison.

topics.headline: final landing after majority and effort
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah end not on the addressee's effort but on the denied identity that resolves the whole frame.
topics.reason: The predicate is postponed through the concessive clause and lands as the final word under the reinforcing particle.

topics.headline: sound catch and extended close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a catch inside the final word and a long ending that leaves the denied identity resonating.
topics.reason: The sound rows describe a local acoustic payoff that supports the final predicate landing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The quantified subject "most people" is denied the predicate "believers" despite the concessive appeal to the addressee's desire.
baseline_models.mechanism: Numerical abundance can become social dominance and appear to decide what is credible, but the verse severs prevalence from heart-settled assent.

activation_trace.role: Growth in number supplies the literal majority and makes prevalence the pressure tested by the negation.
Numerical rivalry and dominance supply the stronger social inference that a majority can seem to have won the truth by headcount.
Assent in which the heart rests supplies the predicate that numerical dominance cannot itself produce.

changed_reading.before: Many people will fail to believe.
changed_reading.after: Even a numerically dominant public cannot turn prevalence into inwardly settled truth.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun for people stands between abundance and the denial of believing.
baseline_models.mechanism: Visible human company and the familiarity that removes estrangement can form a cohesive social world without creating either inward trust or true security.

activation_trace.role: Manifest human society supplies the public collective whose visibility is not evidence of its assent.
Familiar company that removes loneliness supplies social comfort as a possible substitute for truth-bearing trust.
Heart-stillness in safety and trust supplies the deeper security that mere human familiarity does not guarantee.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports the unbelief of a large human population.
changed_reading.after: The verse distinguishes the comfort of belonging to the visible human crowd from the heart's actual settlement in trust.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The concessive "even if you intensely desire" is placed inside the negation of the majority's believing.
baseline_models.mechanism: Excessive desire can intensify the caller's exertion, but faith names a settled trust and assent inside another subject; the first state has no direct causal access to the second.

activation_trace.role: Excessive desire and urgent appetite supply maximum caller-side intensity while exposing its causal limit.
Inner stillness in security and trust supplies a state that cannot be imposed from outside by another person's urgency.
Heart-resting assent supplies the nonmechanical response whose absence survives even extreme desire for it.

changed_reading.before: Greater prophetic effort should yield more believers.
changed_reading.after: The verse marks an agency boundary: maximal concern can address people but cannot install settled assent within them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence stages a minority recognition as felt finding, a group dismissal of it as old error, and later ocular and epistemic vindication. It makes majority nonbelief partly a social mechanism that misnames an anomalous but accurate perception.

activation_trace.role: Familiar company supplies the cohesive group capable of stabilizing a shared dismissal.
Heart-resting assent supplies the response withheld when group judgment overrides anomalous recognition.
Finding through grief and love supplies an affectively mediated recognition that arrives before public verification.
Deviation from guidance supplies the group's explicit category for disqualifying the minority perception.
Restored ocular sight supplies public verification that reverses the earlier dismissal.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the asymmetry between one person's recognition and the group's lack of knowledge.

structural_cues: 12:94-96 moves from solitary sensing, through collective ridicule, to restored sight and an explicit contrast between knowing and not knowing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies affective finding, a social label of error, restored sight, and asymmetric knowledge; I infer that collective familiarity can suppress uptake by misclassifying an early true signal. A live alternative is that this sequence concerns only the family's local ignorance and does not generalize the mechanism of 12:103.

changed_reading.before: Most people do not believe because the truth has not persuaded them.
changed_reading.after: A majority can fail to believe by socially recoding a valid but minority recognition as error until events force a reversal.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, hidden events become a communicated report through concealed transmission despite the addressee's absence from the scene. The focus therefore denies that closing an evidence-access gap automatically closes the assent gap.

activation_trace.role: Heart-resting assent supplies the response that remains distinct from receiving a report.
An arriving communicated report supplies transmissible content from beyond the addressee's direct witness.
Concealment from eyes supplies the ordinary access barrier that the report crosses.
Knowledge cast in hidden fashion supplies disclosure without ordinary co-presence at the event.

structural_cues: 12:102 immediately precedes the focus and contrasts detailed disclosure with the addressee's absence when the plot was jointly formed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an unseen event, a report, hidden transmission, and absent eyewitness access; I infer that disclosure removes an access objection but cannot itself cause trust. A live alternative is that 12:103 functions only as consolation after the report, without specifying an epistemic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: People might believe if they received otherwise inaccessible evidence.
changed_reading.after: Even a disclosed account of events beyond ordinary witness remains report-shaped knowledge whose reception requires trust rather than mere informational availability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The verse after the focus supplies visible signs, repeated traversal, and bodily turning-away as a causal sequence: evidence can remain plentiful and exposed while attention treats it as scenery and never lets it settle into assent.

activation_trace.role: Settled assent supplies the unrealized endpoint of the perceptual sequence.
A manifest sign supplies evidence that is already available to perception rather than hidden.
Passing and traversing supply repeated contact without stopping for uptake.
Turning one's side supplies the active attentional deflection that interrupts contact before assent.

structural_cues: 12:105 pairs the abundance expression "how many a sign" with coordinated ongoing actions: they pass over signs while turning away from them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies manifest signs, traversal, and turning; I infer the arrow sign exposure -> attentional bypass -> failure of settled assent. A live alternative is that the signs are fully noticed and then consciously rejected rather than bypassed.

changed_reading.before: The majority's nonbelief reflects insufficient evidence or insufficient exhortation.
changed_reading.after: The majority may inhabit an evidence-rich world yet rehearse nonbelief through the repeated micro-action of passing signs without inwardly turning toward them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate continuation repeats both "most" and "believe" but places belief inside an exception where association coexists with it; the next verse rotates the same security root toward feeling safe from an overwhelming arrival. Nonbelief is thus not only blank refusal but assent divided by competing allegiance and reinforced by misplaced safety.

activation_trace.role: Numerical abundance supplies the majority category that the next sequence explicitly reuses.
Heart-resting assent supplies the apparently binary predicate that the continuation complicates.
Assent is grammatically retained, preventing the majority from being flattened into simple absence of all acknowledgment.
The repeated majority marks this mixed state as the direct expansion of the focus quantifier.
Participation and shared ownership supply divided allegiance within, rather than merely outside, professed assent.
Feeling secure supplies the complacent heart-settlement that can counterfeit the security of truthful trust.

structural_cues: 12:106 restages the focus lexemes "most" and "believe" with an exceptive clause of coexistence, then 12:107 pivots from believing to feeling secure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated majority and assent, coexistence with association, and a question about security; I infer divided allegiance plus complacency as one mechanism of the focus negation. A live alternative is that the exception exposes the professed belief as wholly invalid rather than preserving any partial assent.

changed_reading.before: Most people are simply outside belief despite the caller's effort.
changed_reading.after: The majority can display real acknowledgment yet fail the verse's fuller believing because allegiance is partitioned and worldly security is mistaken for trustworthy heart-settlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence does not cancel effort after denying its control over results. It purifies effort into unpaid reminding and speech that inclines without coercion, then locates the invitation on heart-insight rather than conversion count.

activation_trace.role: Excessive desire supplies the caller's live urgency that needs ethical redirection rather than erasure.
Payment for work supplies the transaction explicitly removed from the caller-audience relation.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies a nonpurchasing mode of address whose uptake remains with the hearer.
Calling and inclining through speech supply persuasive movement without an arrow of forced inner conversion.
Insight of the heart supplies the epistemic ground and quality-control criterion for the continuing invitation.

structural_cues: 12:104 immediately negates payment after the focus, while 12:108 preserves first-person calling, grounds it on insight, and extends it through followers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies no wage, reminder, verbal invitation, and heart-insight; I infer that 12:103 separates fidelity of means from numerical success and redirects zeal toward transparent nontransactional address. A live alternative is that the no-wage statement only defends motive and does not redefine the function of zeal.

changed_reading.before: If intense concern cannot produce belief, the caller's effort is futile.
changed_reading.after: Concern remains active as unpaid, insight-led invitation, but its integrity rather than its conversion yield defines the caller's responsibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence stretches messenger labor to the cutoff of hope and unstable judgment before help arrives and rescue separates out those willed. The focus becomes a warning against reading a prolonged low response as either proof of failed mission or a result controllable by more intensity.

activation_trace.role: Extreme desire supplies the sustained mission pressure whose temporal horizon is extended by the later sequence.
Hope cut off supplies the experiential endpoint reached before reversal, showing that visible response can remain absent for a long interval.
An outcome not securely known supplies the unstable assessment generated by delay.
Aid that manifests and supports supplies a reversal arriving from beyond the messengers' exhausted effort.
Rescue by separation supplies a selective outcome rather than a conversion curve proportional to exertion.

structural_cues: 12:110 orders despair and uncertain judgment before the sudden arrival of help and the selective rescue of those willed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exhausted hope, uncertain outcome, arriving aid, and selective rescue; I infer a boundary between mission labor and the timing and distribution of results. A live alternative is that 12:110 recalls earlier messengers only and does not directly interpret the addressee's desire in 12:103.

changed_reading.before: The majority's present nonbelief is a stable metric of failed effort.
changed_reading.after: Present response is a poor mission metric: effort may reach despair before an externally timed and selectively distributed reversal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence offers a reception pathway rather than an information deficit: follow the narrative trace, transfer one case into a lesson for another, let reason restrain folly, and receive gentle direction. Nonbelief occurs when that inferential crossing fails even though the story is detailed.

activation_trace.role: Settled assent supplies the endpoint that narrative material can invite but not automatically generate.
Following a trace supplies the readerly operation of tracking consequences through the story.
Taking one condition as instruction for another supplies the inferential crossing from narrated case to the hearer's own condition.
Reason that restrains ignorance supplies the binding operation that keeps observed consequences from being dismissed.
Gentle indication toward the true path supplies guidance as direction rather than forced transport.

structural_cues: 12:109 commands travel, viewing consequences, and reasoning; 12:111 names story, lesson, detailed exposition, guidance, and a believing people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies trace-following, analogical lesson, restraining reason, and gentle direction; I infer a staged uptake pathway whose interruption explains why detailed narrative need not yield majority belief. A live alternative is that these are independent benefits of the story rather than a causal reception sequence.

changed_reading.before: A sufficiently complete story should persuade most hearers.
changed_reading.after: Narrative detail becomes belief only through active trace-following and self-implicating inference; guidance points along that route but does not carry the majority across it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the split-and-peel branch of the focus verb rather than its ordinary excessive-desire branch. It remains anchored in the exact focus form and is sharpened by the later image of detailed disaggregation, but downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy, not as the contextual lexical sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The exact focus verb can carry a branch image of splitting or peeling, while the denied result remains inward security and assent.

activation_trace.role: Splitting and peeling supply the exploratory image of effort scoring or stripping a surface to reach what lies within.
Inner stillness and trust supply the interior state that surface-working cannot fabricate.
Detail that exposes parts and meanings supplies thorough disaggregation as a context echo without granting it causal power over trust.

changed_reading.before: More intense desire penetrates resistance and produces faith.
changed_reading.after: One may split, peel, and detail every available surface of the case, yet no amount of analytic penetration can carve settled trust into another heart.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the human-image-in-the-pupil branch behind the focus noun for people. It remains anchored in that focus inventory and in the context's restored sight and passing visual field, but downstream prose should mark it as an optical analogy rather than an etymological replacement for "people."
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun for the visible human collective has a branch image of the human figure reflected in the pupil.

activation_trace.role: The human image in the pupil supplies an optical miniature of the many visible people who fill one's field of judgment.
Numerical abundance enlarges that visible field until crowd image can be mistaken for epistemic weight.
Ocular sight restored supplies the context's explicit concern with what becomes visible to the eye.
Passing across supplies signs moving through the visual field without becoming inward assent.

changed_reading.before: "Most people" is only a demographic count.
changed_reading.after: The visible crowd can fill the perceiver's eye and dominate judgment, while optical presence and numerical salience still fail to amount to faith.

strongest_changes: 12:106 revises a binary absence model into compromised assent: the repeated majority believes in one register while partitioning allegiance.
12:105 supplies an attentional mechanism in which abundant manifest signs are repeatedly traversed and actively turned away from.
12:104 and 12:108 redefine uncontrolling zeal as unpaid reminder and insight-led invitation rather than result-producing force.
12:110 makes response temporally nonlinear: mission effort can reach despair before aid and selective rescue arrive.
12:109-111 makes belief an inferential crossing from followed narrative traces to self-applying lesson, not an automatic effect of detail.
summary.what_was_special: The same focus roots rotate across the context: abundance and believing recur together in 12:106, while security moves from safe entry in 12:99 to complacent safety in 12:107 and assent returns in 12:111. This supports several coexisting readings of nonbelief as divided allegiance, attentional bypass, social misclassification, and failed inferential uptake rather than one final explanation.
remaining_uncertainties: The exception in 12:106 can preserve partial acknowledgment or expose that acknowledgment as invalid; both remain live.
The 12:94-96 recognition sequence may model majority dynamics or may remain a local family episode.
The peeling branch of desire and the pupil-image branch of people are valid packet-anchored analogies but should remain explicitly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Excessive desire cannot manufacture trusting assent in the many.** ك ث ر B001, ح ر ص B002 (greedy excessive desire), and ء م ن B002 distinguish the caller’s effort from the hearers’ assent. I infer that intensity of concern does not causally compel belief. The ayah places a limit on human influence after the story’s many successful stratagems.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:104-111 showed the response to limited belief was still cost-free reminder, visible signs, reasoned travel, and detailed guidance rather than coercion.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Intense desire denied causal control over assent.** `ح ر ص:B002` is excessive longing or will, including eagerness for guidance; `ء م ن:B002` is trusting assent or confirmation. The concessive *wa-law ḥaraṣta* places even maximal concern before the negative prediction that most people will not believe. The packet supplies the intensity and the withheld result; I infer that sincere human eagerness may sustain invitation but cannot manufacture another person's assent. The ayah prevents the narrator's newly asserted revelatory warrant in 12:102 from being mistaken for automatic persuasive success.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:111 calls the account guidance and mercy for people who assent, preserving the tension here: the message can be fitted to belief without coercively producing belief in most hearers.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin ya da ayrık bir niceliğin az olmayacak ölçüde bulunması veya sayıca artmasıdır. Buna bir şeyi çok duruma getirme ve ondan çokça edinme gibi bu çekirdekten türeyen işlemler de bağlanır.

facets.statement: Çokluk, azlığın karşıtıdır ve özellikle sayılabilen varlıklarda sayının yüksekliğini ya da artışını bildirir.

Az ve çok, malın ya da içinde bulunulan durumun iki karşıt ölçüsünü birlikte anan kalıpta kullanılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar çokluğu azlığın karşıtı, sayının artması ve bir şeyin çok olması diye ortaklaştırır; ayrıca çoklaştırma, çokça edinme ve çokluk bildiren niteleme biçimlerini aynı anlam alanına bağlar.

facets.statement: Belirli kişi ve durum kalıpları, malın, sözün, isteklerin veya hakların bir kişiye bağlı çokluğunu bildirir.

Edilgen yapı, kişiden iyilik isteyenlerin veya onun üzerindeki hakların çokluğunu bildirir.
Bir başka kalıp, kişinin başkasının malına dayanarak kendini çok malı varmış gibi göstermesini anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aynı sözlük birimini cennetteki özel ırmak, bol ve büyük iyilik, ayrıca iyiliği ve bağışı bol cömert önder için kullanır. Dal bu sözlüksel çokanlamlılık olarak korunabilir; bu üç gönderim tek bir varlık tanımıymış gibi birleştirilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Irmak, bol iyilik ve cömert kişi ayrı sözlüksel gerçekleşmelerdir; ortak bağları olağanüstü bolluk düşüncesidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın bir çokluk anlamı kurmak yerine verilen sözcük ve kişi kalıbına bağlı üç özel kullanımı ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Olağanüstü bolluk bildiren özel bir sözlük birimi, cennetteki bir ırmağı veya bol ve büyük iyiliği adlandırır; kişi kalıbında ise iyiliği ve bağışı bol, cömert bir önderi niteler.

facets.statement: Sözlük birimi cennette bulunan ve başka ırmakların kendisinden ayrıldığı özel bir ırmağı adlandırır.
Sözlük biriminin ortak çekirdeği, ırmak, iyilik ve kişi kullanımlarını olağanüstü bolluk düşüncesine bağlar.
Kişi kalıbında iyiliği ve bağışı çok, cömert ve önder bir erkek nitelenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar özel sözlük birimini cennetteki bir ırmak ve bol ya da büyük iyilik olarak açıklar; kişi için kullanıldığında cömertliği, önderliği, iyilik ve bağış bolluğunu bildirir. Bir açıklamada cennet ırmaklarının çoğunun ondan ayrıldığı, bir diğerinde ise bol iyiliğin Peygamber'e verildiği belirtilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sözlük biriminin iki temel açıklamasını birlikte gösterir; kişi nitelemesi ayrıca bağlama bağlıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Özel ırmak ile bol iyilik açıklamalarını ayrı seçenekler olarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Başka ırmakların kendisinden ayrıldığı bildirilen cennet ırmağı anlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Irmak oluşunu ve cennete özgü gönderimi korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yoğunlaşıp yükselen tozu adlandıran özel kullanımla bir şeyin son derece çoğalmasını bildiren biçimi birlikte verir. Ortak aşırı çokluk bağı dalı korur, ancak toz görüntüsü genel çoğalma anlamının zorunlu parçası değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Toz kullanımı yükselme veya kabarma görüntüsüne bağlıdır; genel biçim ise yalnız aşırı derecede çoğalmayı bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, toza bağlı kalıbı ve genel aşırı çoğalma biçimini ayrı yüzler olarak tutar; toz özelliğini yalın çoğalma anlamına taşımaz.

concept_map.definition: Toz kalıbında, çok olup kabaran veya havada belirgin biçimde yükselen yoğun tozu anlatır. Ayrı bir biçimde ise herhangi bir şeyin son derece çoğalmasını bildirir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek olağanüstü çokluktur; toz kalıbında bu çokluk kabarıp havada yükselen yoğun bir görünüm alır.
Toz dışındaki bir şey için kullanılan biçim, onun aşırı ve son sınıra varan ölçüde çoğalmasını bildirir.
Ölüm sahnesindeki tozun kabarıp çoklaşması, yoğun toz kullanımına örnek oluşturur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, çokluğu yüzünden kabarıp yükselen yoğun tozu ve bir şeyin son derece çoğalmasını aynı aşırılık alanında birleştirir; kabaran ölüm tozu bu kullanıma örnek verilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ortak ağırlığı hurma ağacının yenilebilir iç göbeğindedir; bazı açıklamalar bunu ağacın çekilen öz bölümü veya çiçek salkımının ilk oluşumu olarak genişletir. Dal korunabilir, fakat bu ikinci açıklama kesin eşdeğer gibi sunulmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel gönderim hurma ağacının iç göbeğidir; çiçek salkımının ilk oluşumu kaynaklarda verilen daha geniş bir açıklamadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, bitki adını çekirdek alır; söz içindeki kullanım ve ağacın çiçeklenmesini bildiren biçim ayrı bağlı kullanımlar olarak korunur.

facets.statement: Temel gönderim, hurma ağacının tepesindeki yumuşak ve yenilebilir iç göbektir.
Bazı açıklamalar aynı adı hurmanın çiçek salkımının ilk oluşumuna da verir.
Bir ceza sözünde bu hurma ürünü, meyveyle birlikte el kesme cezasının uygulanmadığı şeyler arasında anılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar adı çoğunlukla hurma ağacının iç göbeği ve çekilen öz bölümü için verir; bir açıklama çiçek salkımının ilk oluşumunu da kapsar ve yaygın bir sözde meyveyle birlikte anılır. Ad için kaynaklarda birden fazla harekeleme ve okunuş biçimi de aktarılır.

Görünür olma açıklaması adlandırma gerekçesidir; insan olmanın kurucu tanımı değildir. Evde kimsenin bulunmadığını bildiren kalıp ise dal çekirdeğine genellenemez ve yalnızca kendi sözcüksel biriminde korunmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçimlerdeki insan ve insan topluluğu anlamı dal çekirdeğidir; evde hiç kimse bulunmadığını anlatan kalıp ayrı tutulur ve çekirdeğe yeni bir genel anlam katmaz.

Çevreye bakıp dikkatle araştırarak birinin bulunup bulunmadığını anlamaya çalışma kullanımını taşır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الأنس أنس الإنسان بالشيء إذا لم يستوحش منه (maqayis)؛ الإيناس خلاف الإيحاش والإنس خلاف الوحشة والأنيس المؤانس وكل ما يؤنس به (sihah)؛ أنست بفلان أي فرحت به والأنس والاستئناس هو التأنس وكلب أنوس نقيض العقور (tahdhib)؛ الأنس خلاف النفور ولكل ما يؤنس به (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin güvenilir çekirdeği, bir şeyin insana veya onu kullanan kişiye dönük ve yakın olan yanıdır. Bu yanın solda mı sağda mı olduğu konusunda aktarımlar uyuşmaz; hayvan ve yay örnekleri yönü işlevsel ilişkiyle belirler. Bu nedenle sabit bir sağ-sol tanımı dalın özüne konamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, bir nesnenin insana veya kullanıcıya bakan yanını belirtir; salt sol, salt sağ, genel ön taraf ya da insanın kendisi anlamına gelmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak dalın insana dönük yan çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır. Hayvan ve yay uygulamaları bu çekirdeğin örneklenmesidir; yalnız bu kullanımlardan yeni bir genel yön anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir nesnenin insana, kullanıcıya veya onun bulunduğu yöne bakan yanıdır. Hayvan ve yay üzerinde işlevsel ilişkiyle belirlenir; bu yanın sabit olarak sol ya da sağ sayılması konusunda aktarım uyuşmazlığı vardır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin insana en yakın olan veya insana doğru bakan yanını belirtir.
Hayvanda binicinin bulunduğu, binme ve sağma işlemlerinde insana yakın olan yanı anlatır.
Yayda okçuya doğru bakan ve kullanıcının karşısında bulunan yanı anlatır.
İnsana yakın yan bazı aktarımda sol, başka bir aktarımda sağ diye belirlenir; yönün özü bu değişken tanımlardan bağımsızdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlam, nesnenin insana veya kullanıcıya dönük yanıdır; hayvanda biniciye, yayda okçuya göre belirlenir. İnsan bedenindeki tekil uygulamada öteki bacağa bakan yan kastedilir. Bu yanın solda mı sağda mı bulunduğuna ilişkin anlatımlar ayrıştığı için genel tanım sabit bir yön seçmez.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesnenin yönü, ona yaklaşan veya onu kullanan insana göre belirlendiğinde dalın ortak çekirdeğini verir.

error_profile.preserves: Yanı sabit sağ veya sola bağlamadan insana göre yönelmiş olmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hayvanın binme ve sağma sırasında insana yakın kalan yanı anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanın yanını biniciyle kurduğu işlevsel ilişkiye göre belirler.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yayın kullanım sırasında okçuya doğru dönük olan yüzü belirtilirken uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yay yüzünün yönünü okçunun konumuna göre belirleme özelliğini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal insana veya kullanıcıya yakın ve ona bakan yanı gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir şeyin arkasında kalan, yüzünün karşıtı olan arka bölümünü gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: insana bakan yan ile arka taraf
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir nesnenin başka bir yöne göre belirlenen bölümünü adlandırır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه إنسي الدابة والقوس وكل شيئين: ما يلي الإنسان أو يقبل على الراكب أو الرامي، في مقابلة الوحشي.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل الإنسان نفسه ولا الأنس النفسي ولا الإبصار.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الإنسي الأيسر من كل شيء وقيل الأيمن وما أقبل منهما على الإنسان فهو إنسي وإنسي القوس ما أقبل عليك منها (sihah)؛ الإنسي من الدواب الجانب الأيسر الذي منه يركب ويحتلب ومن الإنسان الجانب الذي يلي الرجل الأخرى (tahdhib)؛ إنسي الدابة للجانب الذي يلي الراكب وإنسي القوس للجانب الذي يقبل على الرامي (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ortak çekirdeği, gözün kara bölümünde görülen küçük insan biçimli görüntü veya yansımadır. Parmak ucu anlamı tek aktarım içinde eklenir ve gözdeki görüntünün kurucu parçası değildir; bağımlı bir kaynak varyantı olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal göz bebeğinde görülen küçük görüntüyü, ayrıca ayrı bir aktarım olarak parmak ucunu kapsar; gözün kendisini veya genel insan türünü belirtmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dalın çekirdeği gözün kara bölümündeki küçük görüntüdür. Parmak ucu aktarımı bağımlı bir varyanttır; gözle ilgili belirli biçimlerden genel görüntü veya genel insan anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Gözün kara bölümünde görülen küçük insan biçimli görüntü veya yansımadır. Ayrı bir kaynak kullanımında aynı ad parmak ucuna da verilir, ancak bu kullanım göz görüntüsü çekirdeğini değiştirmez.

facets.statement: Göz bebeğinin kara bölümünde görülen küçük insan biçimli görüntüyü veya yansımayı adlandırır.
Ayrı bir aktarımda parmak ucu veya eldeki parmak ucunu anlatan kullanım da aynı adla verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak aktarım, göz bebeğinin kara bölümünde görülen küçük görüntüyü bir insan biçimi olarak tanımlar. Buna ek olarak parmak ucu anlamı da bildirilir, fakat bu ek kullanım gözdeki yansıma çekirdeğinden ayrı tutulur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir bakanın göz bebeğinde beliren küçük insan biçimli görüntü adlandırıldığında dalın ortak ve temel anlamını karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Görüntünün göz bebeğindeki konumunu, küçüklüğünü ve yansıma niteliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yansımanın insan biçiminde algılanması özellikle belirtilmek istendiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Görüntünün göz bebeğinde bulunmasını ve küçük insan biçiminde görünmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnız parmak ucunu aynı adla veren ayrı kaynak kullanımında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Göz anlamından bağımsız olan parmak ucu kullanımını doğrudan korur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه إنسان العين: المثال أو الصبي الذي يرى في سواد العين، وما ألحقه تهذيب اللغة من الأنملة أو إنسان الكف.

branches.source_phrase_ar: إنسان العين صبيها الذي في السواد (maqayis)؛ إنسان العين المثال الذي يرى في السواد أي سواد العين (sihah)؛ الإنسان أيضا إنسان العين وجمعه أناسي والإنسان الأنملة (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki ayrı kalıplaşmış ilişkiyi açıkça ayırır: kişiye kendi durumunu soran sözde kişinin kendisi, bir başkasına bağlanan sözde ise seçilmiş yakın ve sırdaş kastedilir. Yakın arkadaş ve oturup konuşulan kişi için verilen paralel adlar ikinci alanı destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız belirtilen söz kuruluşlarında kişinin kendisini veya seçkin yakınını gösterir; genel insan, gerçek evlatlık ve her türlü arkadaşlık anlamına genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kişinin kendisini soran kuruluş, seçilmiş yakını belirten kuruluş ve yakın arkadaş adları ayrı tutulur. Bunların hiçbiri çıplak biçime genel kişi veya akrabalık anlamı olarak taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir soru kuruluşunda muhatabın kendisini ve durumunu, başka bir kişiyle kurulan adlandırmada ise onun seçilmiş yakınını, sırdaşını veya sürekli görüştüğü arkadaşını belirtir. İki kullanım aynı kuruluş ailesinde bulunsa da katılımcı ilişkileri ayrıdır.

facets.statement: Bir kişiye kendi durumunu soran belirli kuruluşta muhatabın kendisini gösterir.
Bir kişiye bağlanarak söylendiğinde onun seçilmiş yakınını, özel arkadaşını veya sırdaşını belirtir.
Aynı anlam çevresindeki paralel adlar yakın dostu, içten arkadaşı ve oturup konuşulan kişiyi gösterebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar, doğrudan hitapta kişinin kendi durumunu soran kullanım ile birinin seçkin yakını ve sırdaşını gösteren kullanımı birlikte verir. Yakın dost ve sürekli görüşülen arkadaş anlamındaki paralel adlar ikinci ilişki alanını genişletir.

concept_gloss.text: belirli sözlerde kişinin kendisi veya seçilmiş yakını
concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız kaynakta gösterilen soru ve kişi bağlantısı kuruluşlarını topluca açıklarken kullanılabilir; genel bir kişi ya da akraba adı değildir.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin kendisi ile onun seçilmiş yakını arasındaki iki ayrı gönderimi ve kuruluş sınırlamasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Muhataba kendi durumunun nasıl olduğu sorulduğunda doğal Türkçe karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Sorunun muhatabın kendi durumuna yönelmesini korur.

branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل مطلق الإنسان ولا مطلق المؤانسة إلا إذا جاء بصيغة هذا الباب أو قرينته.
branches.source_phrase_ar: كيف ابن إنسك إذا سأله عن نفسه (maqayis)؛ كيف ابن إنسك يعني نفسه وفلان ابن إنس فلان أي صفيه وخاصته وهذا خدني وإنسي وخلصي وجلسي (sihah)؛ كيف ترى ابن إنسك إذا خاطبت الرجل عن نفسه وفلان ابن أنس فلان أي صفيه وأنيسه (tahdhib)؛ قيل ابن إنسك للنفس (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnız eve giriş öncesindeki belirli söz çevresinde açıklanır. Bir aktarım bunu selam verip izin isteme ve girebilir miyim diye sorma olarak, diğeri ise girişe elverişli bir kabul ve yakınlık bulma olarak yorumlar. Dal bu iki açıklamayı korumalı, fakat çıplak biçime genel bakma veya genel rahatlık anlamı yüklememelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal eve girmeden önce izin ve kabul arama durumuyla sınırlıdır; genel görme, genel yakınlık, eve yerleşme veya barınma anlamına gelmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam çözümlenmemiştir ve eldeki kanıt yalnız giriş öncesi kuruluşu gösterir. Bu nedenle tanım bu söz çevresine bağlanır, çıplak bir genel anlam varsayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir eve girmeden önce selam vererek izin istemeyi ve içeridekilerin girişe açık olduğunu anlamayı anlatır. Aktarımın bir yönü doğrudan izin sorusunu, diğer yönü girişe elverişli bir kabul ve yakınlık bulmayı öne çıkarır.

facets.statement: Eve girmeden önce selam verip girmek için izin istemeyi ve kabul beklemeyi anlatır.
Ayrı açıklama, girişten önce içeridekilerden yakınlık ve kabul işareti bulmayı öne çıkarır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Giriş öncesi davranış iki yönden açıklanır: selam verip açıkça izin istemek ve girebilir miyim diye sormak ya da içeridekilerden girişe elverişli bir kabul ve yakınlık bulmak. Her iki açıklama da eve izinsiz girmeme sınırında birleşir.

contextual_glosses.text: selam verip girebilir miyim diye sormak

concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal guvenlik hali degil; bir soz, haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru kabul etme alanidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru sayip ona icten kabul ile yonelmektir. Dini kullanista bu kabul, kalp, dil ve davranisla baglanan bir boyun egme ya da seriate girme anlami kazanabilir.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.
Hakka yonelik ic kabul, yalniz bilmekten ziyade boyun egme ve kabullenme bicimi alir.
Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.
Ilahi sifat kullaniminda vaat edilen odulu dogrulama veya guvenceyle bildirme boyutu one cikar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali dua icinde soylenen bir kabul istegi sozu ve bu sozu soyleme eylemi olarak verir. Cerceve, guven ve tasdik dallarindan ayrildigi ve sadece dua cevabi formuluyle ilgili oldugu icin uygundur.

concept_map.definition: Dua sonunda kabul edilme istegini bildiren ve 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' ya da 'bunu yap' anlaminda aciklanan sabit sozdur. Dal ayrica bu sozu soyleme eylemini ve kaynaklarda aktarılan ad yorumunu da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek, duada kabul istegini bildiren sabit cevap sozudur.
Kaynaklar sozun anlamini 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' veya 'bunu yap' seklinde aciklar.
Bu sozu soyleme eylemi de ayni dal icinde adlandirilir.
Bazi aktarimlarda bu sozun ilahi bir ad oldugu yorumu da dalin yan rivayeti olarak bulunur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak dali dua icinde soylenen ve kabul istegi tasiyan sabit bir soz olarak anlatir. Ayni iddia, bu sozu soyleme eylemini ve sozun anlamina dair 'kabul et' ya da 'oyle olsun' aciklamalarini da icerir; ad yorumu ise bu ortak malzemenin yan aktarimidir.
